svg.text: MULTI-DOMAIN INSTRUMENT PLATFORMS — HARDWARE · FIRMWARE · MOBILE · EVIDENCE
discover capabilities · plan diagnostics · request captures · correlate · evidence-linked reporting
UNIFORM CAPABILITY CONTRACT · EVERY NODE SPEAKS IT
registry · time authority · authz · segmentation · health
any node alone → host · Node D not required
EVERY NODE IS A COMPLETE INSTRUMENT
ROSTER OPEN · A NEW NODE ADDS WITHOUT REDESIGNING THE OTHERS
ONE TIMESTAMP DOMAIN · ONE EVIDENCE MODEL · SHA-256 PROVENANCE
fail-silent / receive-only by default · independent per-channel TX chain · service permission AND supervisor AND FPGA AND MCU request
timing is measured on the bench, never inferred from the presence of an FPGA
